marketLayer.title: US Tech & AI Infrastructure Capex
marketLayer.fact: Major US technology giants reported earnings highlighting sustained high capital expenditure in AI data centers, alongside mixed cloud growth trajectories.
marketLayer.inference: Hyperscaler spending continues to support hardware supply chain revenues, though short-term market sentiment remains sensitive to ROI timelines.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Monetization pace of enterprise AI tools and potential revisions to full-year cloud margin guidance.

marketLayer.title: HK Internet Platform Recovery & Southbound Inflows
marketLayer.fact: The Hang Seng Tech Index closed higher led by heavyweights Tencent and Meituan, supported by net Southbound capital buying exceeding HKD 4 billion.
marketLayer.inference: Institutional capital is returning to attractive valuation levels in Chinese internet leaders amid stabilizing domestic competition and expanding shareholder buyback programs.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Sustainability of Southbound inflows if broader macro consumer recovery data misses market expectations.

marketLayer.title: Global Semiconductor & Export Regulations
marketLayer.fact: Leading chip foundry and equipment makers faced intraday volatility following discussions regarding updated international trade policies and supply chain adjustments.
marketLayer.inference: Supply chain restructuring accelerates domestic substitution trends in Asian markets, while global chip suppliers face regional revenue fragmentation.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Specific timeline and regulatory scope of newly proposed cross-border tech restrictions.

marketLayer.title: China New Energy Vehicles & Consumer Stimulus
marketLayer.fact: Hong Kong-listed EV makers and consumer discretionary stocks gained traction following policy briefings signaling extended auto trade-in subsidies and regional consumption vouchers.
marketLayer.inference: Targeted fiscal stimulus provides downside protection for vehicle sales volumes in H2, favoring well-capitalized industry leaders with strong export channels.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Price war intensity among domestic auto manufacturers potentially eroding near-term operating margins.
